facts.fact: Rohan's fallback route (the herdsmen's cut from the third bend behind the stone fold, past the shrine, round the spur to the Saddle's lip) was drawn at the post table two nights before the crossing, by Rohan with a ruler on a single copy in Varun's neat hand; only the two of them saw it.
facts.why: needed to plant C13: the hunters' fires climb the route only Rohan and Varun drew.

facts.fact: Meera's rope signals: three short pulls mean halt, one long pull means come.
facts.why: needed for the rope-work drill beat.

facts.fact: At dusk of this chapter the bundle holds nineteen dry sticks; five are burned for the night and a sixth for Meera's refusal, leaving thirteen. Nine days remain to the Snow Fair and they agree to move within two days.
facts.why: beat requires nineteen sticks, nine days and a two-day deadline.
